author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: clk_a and clk_b are declared -logically_exclusive, yet src_q (clk_a) reaches s1_q, which starts a depth-2 clk_b chain: CDC-037(a) WARNING Established. Settled sites are the union of both readers (crossing endpoints plus the clock-group declaration).

author_reading.rationale: SDC declares clk_a and clk_b logically exclusive, yet RTL carries a full two-stage synchronizer between them: the declared relationship contradicts the observed structure.

labels.rationale: SDC declares logical exclusivity, but src_q feeds a two-stage clk_a-to-clk_b synchronizer that reaches the consumer. This is the observed structure the exclusivity rule treats as contradictory.

intent.sdc:4 declares clk_a and clk_b logically exclusive via set_clock_groups -logically_exclusive, asserting that the two clocks never operate concurrently, yet design.sv:16-17 implements a 2-stage synchronizer (s1_q -> s2_q) crossing from src_q (clk_a) into clk_b (CDC-037 WARNING Established contradiction).

settlement.rationale: clk_a and clk_b are declared -logically_exclusive, yet src_q (clk_a) reaches s1_q, which starts a depth-2 clk_b chain: CDC-037(a) WARNING Established. Settled sites are the union of both readers (crossing endpoints plus the clock-group declaration).
